messages:
maya: opened PR to clarify batch_window semantics and int8 variant behavior for cobalt-6b. needs SDK snippets, a short cold-start vs steady-state note, and a public benchmark link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4897

devon: good call. can we include measured cold-start numbers rather than 'slower'? sara, do we have bench outputs?

sara: pasted numbers from yesterday (A100-80GB, seq=512, batch_window_ms=10): cobalt-6b-f16 steady ~3.2 ms/token; cobalt-6b-int8 steady ~2.1 ms/token; cobalt-6b-int8 cold-start (empty KV) ~6.5 ms/token. tokenization included. will attach gist.

eli: doc changes needed:
1) YAML/SDK snippet showing batching config and safe defaults.
2) compatibility bullet: int8 disables cross-attn KV caching past 4096 and will fall back to f16 for large contexts.

maya: suggested SDK snippet in PR — feel free to copy/edit:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(
    model='cobalt-6b-int8',
    prompt='Summarize: ...',
    batching={'batch_window_ms': 10, 'max_batch_tokens': 2048},
)
print(resp.text)
```

alex: small nit: replace internal bench link with public gist: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/cobalt6b-bench and change units to ms/token. I'll do a quick follow-up to adjust labels.

devon: sara, can you paste the exact bench command? we'll include reproducible steps.

sara: bench command: `python bench/run_throughput.py --model cobalt-6b-int8 --seq 512 --batch_window_ms 10 --trials 20`

eli: add migration checklist to the card: try batch_window_ms=10; if many cold-starts, add warmup calls or prefix caching; for streaming, prefer batch_window_ms <=5.

maya: docs-bot status?

docs-bot: checklist: [x] snippet added, [ ] bench gist linked, [ ] compat bullet approved by runtime, [ ] copyedit pending.

devon: runtime approved the compat bullet in DM. once gist link and copyedit are in, mergeable.

maya: I'll update PR with gist and Eli's checklist. planning to merge tomorrow morning unless someone objects.

eli: I'll proofread prior to merge.

maya: thanks all. merging soon. :rocket:
